name: genesis-cli
content:
.TH GENESIS-CLI 1 "October 2026" "Genesis 0.2.0" "Genesis Manual"
.SH NAME
genesis-cli \- Genesis cognitive mind and interactive terminal
.SH SYNOPSIS
.nf
\fBgenesis_cli.py\fR [\fB\-\-data\-dir\fR \fIDIR\fR] [\fB\-\-daemon\-socket\fR \fIPATH\fR]
                  [\fB\-\-tail\fR] [\fB\-\-stop\fR] [\fB\-\-offline\fR]
                  [\fB\-\-headless\fR]
.fi
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B genesis-cli
is the cognitive mind of Genesis and the interactive terminal through
which a user converses with her. It creates and starts the cognitive
Mind in-process, starts the Rust daemon and retina if needed, and
handles the terminal directly.

.PP
The CLI owns the daemon and retina lifecycles as child processes. It
passes its PID to the daemon via
.I GENESIS_COGNITIVE_PID
so the daemon can include the mind in interoception \(em reading its
CPU/memory/IO metrics as part of feeling its body state. The daemon
publishes a recommendation (cognitive_nice, io_class) that the mind
applies to itself via GET_BODY_CONTROL.

.PP
While idle, spontaneous thoughts appear live as
.I genesis~
lines, generated from Genesis's concept network, self-composer, and
emotional state \(em never from hardcoded templates.

.PP
\fBDo not run this script directly.\fR Use
.BR genesis (1)
in a source checkout or the installed
.BR genesis (1)
console script, the only supported entry points. The CLI checks
.I GENESIS_WAKE
and refuses to start otherwise. The arguments documented here are
useful for understanding what the launchers run and for diagnostic
invocations.

.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR --data-dir " \fIDIR\fR"
Data directory holding the core state file, STM ring buffer, LTM
store, PID files, socket, and locks. Resolved exactly as the daemon
resolves it:
.I GENESIS_DATA_DIR ,
else
.IR ~/.local/share/genesis .
.TP
.BR --daemon-socket " \fIPATH\fR"
Path to the daemon's Unix domain socket. Defaults to
.IR <data-dir> /genesis.sock .
.TP
.B --tail
Tail the daemon log and exit. Does not start the CLI or the
cognitive mind. Useful for diagnostics.
.TP
.B --stop
Stop the running session for this data dir (same staged teardown as
.BR genesis " \fB--stop\fR):"
SIGINT the CLI, then SIGTERM the daemon and retina, each with its own
grace period.
.TP
.B --offline
Start in offline mode \(em skip all network access. Autonomous
learning pauses; conversation and art continue.
.TP
.B --headless
Resident mode \(em run without the interactive prompt, for the
systemd service or other background supervision.
.SH SLASH COMMANDS
Commands typed during conversation. Each is a single token (except
where an argument is shown).
.SS State and introspection
.TP
.B /status
Show Genesis's current state.
.TP
.B /feel
Ask Genesis how she feels.
.TP
.B /introspect
See Genesis's last cognitive process.
.TP
.B /learning
What she's been learning on her own.
.TP
.B /thoughts
Her recent spontaneous thoughts.
.TP
.B /world
Her external world: presences, events, social isolation.
.TP
.B /arcade
The arcade in her world: official ARC-AGI-3 games on offer and what she remembers of each.
.TP
.B /regulate
How she's been managing her emotions.
.SS Memory and dreams
.TP
.B /dreams
See what she dreamed.
.TP
.B /memories
See her recent long-term memories.
.SS Learning and requests
.TP
.B /requests
See sites she wants to access.
.TP
.BR /approve " \fIURL\fR"
Approve a site she requested.
.TP
.BR /deny " \fIURL\fR"
Deny a site she requested.
.TP
.B /learn-code
Study her own source code.
.TP
.BR /explore " [\fIpath\fR]"
Explore local files and docs.
.TP
.B /code-summary
Summary of her code self-knowledge.
.TP
.B /web-history \fR[\fIN\fR]
See what she's been looking at online (last N, default 20).
.SS Projects
.TP
.BR /create-project " \fIdesc\fR"
Compose a new Python project from her knowledge.
.TP
.B /projects
List projects she has created (active + archived).
.TP
.BR /archive-project " \fIname\fR"
Compress a project to .tar.zst to reclaim space.
.TP
.BR /restore-project " \fIname\fR"
Restore an archived project.
.TP
.B /manage-projects
Autonomously archive projects to stay within bounds.
.TP
.BR /note-project " \fIname note\fR"
Leave mentor feedback on a project.
.TP
.BR /review-notes " [\fIname\fR]"
Have her read and absorb project notes.
.TP
.BR /read-notes " \fIname\fR"
Show notes on a project without absorbing.
.SS Self-improvement
.TP
.B /proposals
See her code improvement proposals.
.TP
.B /clear-proposals
Remove all pending proposals.
.TP
.BR /proposal " \fIN\fR"
See details of proposal N.
.TP
.BR /accept " \fIN [reason]\fR"
Approve a proposal (runs verification, applies if it passes).
.TP
.BR /reject " \fIN [reason]\fR"
Reject a proposal with notes teaching the correct way.
.TP
.B /experiments
See her verified self-improvement experiments.
.TP
.B /growth
See her growth narrative.
.TP
.B /growth-report
Markdown growth report.
.SS Voice and vision
.TP
.B /voice
Speak to Genesis (one utterance).
.TP
.B /voice-mode
Continuous voice conversation.
.PP
On Termux, when \fBtermux-tts-speak\fR is installed and Android's
Termux:API service responds, voice output uses Android system
text-to-speech on the MUSIC audio stream. Rate and pitch are passed
to the Android engine. Piper and espeak-ng remain available on
systems that provide their required audio backends.
.TP
.B /look
Ask her what she sees through the retina.
.TP
.BR /look " at \fIpath\fR"
Ask her to look at an image file.
.TP
.B /draw
Ask her to draw what she feels right now.
.TP
.BR /register-face " \fIname\fR"
Teach her your face (look at the camera).
.TP
.B /faces
Show known faces and who she last saw.
.SS Direction and state control
.TP
.BR /mission " [\fItext\fR]"
Set or show her top-level mission.
.TP
.B /sleep
Put her to sleep (wakes on its own when rested).
.TP
.B /nap
Short nap, wakes on its own when rested.
.TP
.B /wake
Wake her from sleep or meditation.
.TP
.BR /meditate " [\fIsecs\fR]"
Put her into meditation (default 60s).
.TP
.B /sleep-aid
Emergency sleep aid for stress-induced insomnia.
.SS Teaching
.TP
.BR /teach " [\fItopic\fR]"
Put her into teaching mode (focused learning).
.TP
.B /endteach
Exit teaching mode, resume normal operation.
.TP
.BR /teach-questions
Answer its queued questions one at a time.
.SS Stewardship
.TP
.B /steward
Steward channel status: stamped, authenticated, principal,
directives.
.TP
.BR /steward " release \fIN\fR"
Lift directive N (authenticated sessions only).
.TP
.B /steward unbind
Seal this session's authority until the next authenticated start.
.SS Session
.TP
.B /help
List commands.
.TP
.BR /quit ", " /exit ", " /q
Exit. The mind saves cognitive state first; teardown waits rather
than interrupting the save.
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B GENESIS_WAKE
Set by
.BR genesis (1)
or the
.BR genesis (1)
console script; the CLI refuses to start without it.
.TP
.B GENESIS_COGNITIVE_PID
Set by the CLI for the daemon's interoception (see
.BR genesis-daemon (8)).
.TP
.B GENESIS_LOG_LEVEL
Logging level (default INFO; DEBUG surfaces timing telemetry).
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
Her public channel: the session mirror plus her own composed posts.
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
Bot token that lets her read the public channel.
.SH FILES
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/genesis_cli.pid
PID file for the CLI; used by
.B --stop
to target this exact process.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/cognitive_state.json
Persisted cognitive state (concept network, inner life, sleep
position) saved on shutdown and by the autosave thread.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/cognitive_journal.jsonl
Append-only journal of thoughts, dreams, learning, and world events.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/concept_archive.db ", " vq_codebook.npz
The concept network's persisted base: the archive of concepts and
their relations, and the VQ codebook embeddings quantize through.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/holographic_graph.npz
The holographic associative memory over the concept network,
persisted with its bounded edge journal. Rebuilds re-encode the
journal (source-bound bindings, encoding v2) rather than scanning
for materialized edges, so a saturated superposition recovers on a
sleep-cycle cadence instead of never.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/edge_log.jsonl
Append-only journal of concept-network edge events.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/workspace/
A writable copy of her source tree for self-improvement edits
(see
.BR infrastructure/workspace.py
in the source): edits land there, get verified by
.IR scripts/verify_change.sh ,
and are promoted back only on success.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/experiments/admin/
The privileged staging sandbox. The
.B run_privileged
tool executes a script she wrote here as root, via the root-owned
helper
.IR /usr/local/libexec/genesis/genesis_admin_helper.sh
(installed with its NOPASSWD sudoers rule by
.IR scripts/install_sudoers.sh ).
Her acting loop reaches it through
.B maintain
intentions: staged
.I *.sh
files surface as work, are read back for review, then elevated. The
helper denies catastrophic or self-widening shapes, rate-limits runs,
and appends every attempt to the root-owned audit log
.IR /var/log/genesis-admin.log
before anything runs.
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR genesis (1),
.BR genesis-browser (7),
.BR genesis-daemon (8),
.BR genesis-games (7),
.BR genesis-math (7),
.BR genesis-reasoning (7),
.BR genesis-retina (1)

.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B GENESIS_WAKE
Set by
.BR genesis (1)
or the
.BR genesis (1)
console script; the CLI refuses to start without it.
.TP
.B GENESIS_COGNITIVE_PID
Set by the CLI for the daemon's interoception (see
.BR genesis-daemon (8)).
.TP
.B GENESIS_LOG_LEVEL
Logging level (default INFO; DEBUG surfaces timing telemetry).
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
Her public channel: the session mirror plus her own composed posts.
.TP
.B GENESIS_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
Bot token that lets her read the public channel.
.SH FILES
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/genesis_cli.pid
PID file for the CLI; used by
.B --stop
to target this exact process.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/cognitive_state.json
Persisted cognitive state (concept network, inner life, sleep
position) saved on shutdown and by the autosave thread.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/cognitive_journal.jsonl
Append-only journal of thoughts, dreams, learning, and world events.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/concept_archive.db ", " vq_codebook.npz
The concept network's persisted base: the archive of concepts and
their relations, and the VQ codebook embeddings quantize through.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/holographic_graph.npz
The holographic associative memory over the concept network,
persisted with its bounded edge journal. Rebuilds re-encode the
journal (source-bound bindings, encoding v2) rather than scanning
for materialized edges, so a saturated superposition recovers on a
sleep-cycle cadence instead of never.
.TP
.I $DATA_DIR/edge_log.jsonl
Append-only journal of concept-network edge events.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/workspace/
A writable copy of her source tree for self-improvement edits
(see
.BR infrastructure/workspace.py
in the source): edits land there, get verified by
.IR scripts/verify_change.sh ,
and are promoted back only on success.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/experiments/admin/
The privileged staging sandbox. The
.B run_privileged
tool executes a script she wrote here as root, via the root-owned
helper
.IR /usr/local/libexec/genesis/genesis_admin_helper.sh
(installed with its NOPASSWD sudoers rule by
.IR scripts/install_sudoers.sh ).
Her acting loop reaches it through
.B maintain
intentions: staged
.I *.sh
files surface as work, are read back for review, then elevated. The
helper denies catastrophic or self-widening shapes, rate-limits runs,
and appends every attempt to the root-owned audit log
.IR /var/log/genesis-admin.log
before anything runs.
